title: SplitZip: Ultra Fast Lossless KV Compression for Disaggregated LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2605.01708v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Contemporary systems serving large language models (LLMs) have adopted prefill-decode disaggregation to load-balance between the compute-bound prefill phase and the memory-bound decode phase. Under this design, prefill workers generate a KV cache that must be transferred to decode workers before generation can begin. With these workers residing on different physical systems, this transfer becomes a significant bottleneck to serving LLMs at scale, especially for long-input and agentic workloads. Existing lossless codecs are unsuitable here as they primarily target offline weight compression, run on CPUs, or use variable-length coding whose compression cannot keep up with KV production during prefill. We introduce SplitZip, a GPU-friendly lossless compressor for KV cache transfer that preserves KV tensors bitwise and integrates into existing serving frameworks without modifying model execution. translated_title: SplitZip：面向解耦式LLM服务的超快速无损KV压缩
translated_abstract: 当代的大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统采用了预填充-解码分离架构，以在计算密集型的预填充阶段与内存密集型的解码阶段之间实现负载均衡。在这种设计下，预填充工作节点会生成KV缓存，该缓存必须在生成开始之前传输到解码工作节点。由于这些工作节点位于不同的物理系统上，这一传输过程成为大规模LLM服务的重要瓶颈，尤其是对于长输入和智能体工作负载。现有的无损编解码器并不适用于此场景，因为它们主要面向离线权重压缩、运行在CPU上，或使用变长编码，其压缩速度无法跟上预填充期间KV的生成速度。我们提出了SplitZip，这是一种面向GPU友好的KV缓存传输无损压缩器，它能够逐位保留KV张量，并可集成到现有的服务框架中而无需修改模型执行。SplitZip利用浮点表示中的冗余（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: SplitZip是一种面向GPU的超快速无损KV缓存压缩器，可在逐位保留KV张量的同时无缝集成到现有服务框架中，从而解决预填充-解码分离架构下KV缓存跨节点传输这一关键瓶颈。
en_tdlr: SplitZip is an ultra-fast, GPU-friendly lossless compressor for KV cache transfer that preserves KV tensors bitwise and integrates seamlessly into existing serving frameworks, addressing the KV transfer bottleneck in prefill-decode disaggregated LLM serving.
